Name: Colorful Chairs and Couches
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Do YOU want more colors for your chairs and couches? No? Well now you can have more anyways 'cause I said so. I never knew why there weren't at least one of every type of color of chair/couch, and I also didn't understand why the long couch wasn't in all colors. Now there's no need to worry about that! 

NEW Alternative Textures version added thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/58746061]PurpleChickadee[/url] - Thank you so much :D 

The blue armchair, blue couch, and large brown armchair are the textures for each type of furniture! 


[b]The AT version of this mod works with 1.6!
[/b]



[b]A couple notes:

Due to Custom Furniture limitations:

-You can't really place the armchairs side by side like you can with the normal furniture - it rotates the actual hit box instead of the furniture image itself and I can't really fix that. 

- Sitting on the chairs sideways looks funny so that also doesn't work - but at least you can sit on the forward and backward facing ones! (You can also sit in the middle of the long chairs and that looks fine)

-The set hitboxes for the items isn't dynamic which means that the long couches have hitboxes of 4x1 when sideways which means you can walk on top of them... Unless you don't want to walk around the back of couch I can't really change that unfortunately. [/b]

If you have any other colors that you would want just let me know!

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
